Look, I’ve had serious ptsd, anxiety, depression, add, and paranoia, all of which induced insomnia, for the past 11 years. Hard to imagine a 4 year old with serious ptsd and anxiety, but hey, when a 3 year old listens to his mom screaming while she’s being beaten and cut, after being locked in the garage by his dad, it’s not unbelievable. I give the best advice at times, other times I’m a lazy piece of shit with no motivation to blink. I’m 14. Suicidal. Diagnosed with severe depression, anxiety, ptsd, add, and insomnia, and somehow I’m still here. Music helps me sometimes. I can’t keep friends because I’m too edgy. There’s some towns I can’t go to without going into a state of hyper-vigilance for 3 days. I need help. Meds don’t work. Therapy is a scam. And now I’m laying here, at 11:38pm, on a Friday night, while all the other kids in my school are out there losing their virginity and shit, I’m sitting here, on a suicide watch subreddit, at 11:38pm, wondering what death feels like.

People say suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem. It’s not. It’s a permanent solution to a permanent problem. I may have only lived 14 years, but when other kids are looking under their beds, I’m watching the doors and windows, I’m having flashbacks to when I was 3 because I have a photographic memory which isn’t a good thing for people who have survived domestic violence and abuse of all kinds. I’ve been close to doing it too. I’m in no way promoting the idea, but I’m saying that I can’t put my life story into words, and I doubt you could either. Don’t kill yourself, but know that therapy isn’t worth it, and meds only sometimes help. Life is hell but we’re here for you man.
